facilitators.name: Coinbase CDP Facilitator
facilitators.feeModel: $0.001 per settled payment after the first 1,000 free settlements per month, effective 2026-01-01 (first bills went out 2026-02-01). Listed as "0% fee" on facilitators.x402.watch, which appears to track markup/percentage fee rather than this flat per-settlement charge.
facilitators.kycCustodyNotes: Runs KYT/OFAC screening on transactions it processes; non-custodial in that settled USDC lands directly in the seller's own wallet address rather than a Coinbase-controlled account.
facilitators.notes: The reference/default facilitator most tooling and docs point to.
